question: When odds are unknown, can a retry cap beat retry-until-success?
hypothesis: H5: a retry cap can beat retry-until-success under uncertain odds, but not under known odds.
varied_factor: prior on rare_drop (known p = 0.02, Beta(20, 980), Beta(1, 49), Beta(0.2, 9.8)); prior mean is 0.02 in all four
read_out: DP check (1 Nov): from a full 1800 s budget DP retries rare_drop 75 times with known odds, 72 / 54 / 33 times as the Beta prior weakens. The weaker the prior, the earlier DP gives up. Compare mean reward of fixed-k caps against always (retry-until-success) and DP; a cap should be able to beat always under a weak Beta prior, not under known p = 0.02.
replaces: data/synthetic/uncertain_odds/uncertain_beta_a1_b49_T030min.json (60 s retry, DP never retried; see dp/README.md finding 3)
